# Socipub

> Schedule posts to Twitter, LinkedIn and more with Socipub, the open source social media scheduler. Free, self-hostable alternative to Buffer, Hootsuite, and Postiz.

## Core Features
- [Scheduling](https://socipub.com/scheduling): Schedule posts to Twitter, LinkedIn, and more
- [Multi-Platform](https://socipub.com/multi-platform): Manage multiple social accounts from one dashboard
- [Markdown](https://socipub.com/markdown): Write posts in Markdown with live preview
- [Features](https://socipub.com/features): Full feature overview
- [Dashboard](https://socipub.com/dashboard): Your posting queue and calendar
- [Pricing](https://socipub.com/pricing): Free and paid plans
- [Trust](https://socipub.com/trust): Security, privacy, and self-hosting info
